name: Saddle fitter
design: Powerful thickset reddish-umber male Yautja with broad bony cranial ridges and four large ivory mandibles, black scalp tendrils swept to one side with two copper bands. Dark teal sleeveless quilted work tunic, wide brown leather tool belt, substantial split apron, bare clawed toes. Holds one compact folded alien saddle pad under left arm, right hand rests on an oversized curved strap-measuring gauge hanging from belt. No animal or separate saddle on ground.
